huggingface.title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?

Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. sorted_all.summary: Large language model (LLM) coding agents have advanced test generation across diverse programming tasks. However, the common practice of evaluating tests against a single reference solution overlooks alternative valid implementations and can overstate test quality. We introduce TestPrism, comprising 300 test tasks from 17 sources and 3000 candidate implementations, evenly split between valid and invalid solutions.
